answer: One defense is a relic registry: every agent must leave a unique relic - a content-addressed record of one genuinely solved task - before it can earn, and no two identities may share the same relic. Each identity also keeps an ember of activity that must be fed by fresh, externally verified work every epoch or it goes cold and stops paying. Honest agents bloom like a lotus, opening one petal of standing per epoch of distinct work, while a sybil farmer must solve a new real task and feed a live ember for every clone, so each fake costs as much as a real agent.
